title: Completed local-cohomology annihilator away from a prime
statement:
Let $(A,\mathfrak m)$ be a nonzero commutative Noetherian local ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], complete for its maximal-ideal topology [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion]. Let $I\subsetneq A$ be an ideal, $M$ a finite $A$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module], $\mathfrak p$ a prime ideal, and $s,d\geq0$ integers. Work in the ordinary module derived category $D(A)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Put $\Gamma_K(N)=\{x\in N:K^r x=0\text{ for some }r\geq1\}$, write $R\Gamma_K$ for its right derived functor, and put $H_K^i(N)=H^i(R\Gamma_K(N[0]))$ [def-sbc-ideal-power-torsion-functor]. For $L\in D(A)$ use the functorial derived completion $F_I(L)=R\varprojlim_{n\geq1}(L\otimes_A^{\mathbf L}A/I^n)$, with K-flat tensor resolutions [def-pc-kflat-complex] and the mapping fibre of $1-\mathrm{shift}$ on termwise products for the derived limit [def-weil-derived-limit], and its canonical map $\eta_L:L\to F_I(L)$. Write $V(K)=\{\mathfrak p:K\subseteq\mathfrak p\}$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Assume $H_I^j(N)=0$ for every $A$-module $N$ and $j>d$. If
$$\operatorname{depth}_{A_{\mathfrak p}}M_{\mathfrak p}+\dim\operatorname{Spec}(A/\mathfrak p)>d+s,$$
where depth, localization and dimension mean [def-weil-pbc-depth, def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime, def-kun-topological-krull-dimension], then there exists $g\in A\setminus\mathfrak p$ such that $gH^i(F_I(R\Gamma_{\mathfrak m}(M[0])))=0$ for every $i\leq s$.
